verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own auto-transfer rules, which fire on deposits and move funds by dollar amount or percentage, plus multi-step approval rules. Community feedback confirms automatic partitioning but notes external payments still have to be executed manually. The rules are limited to fund transfers and approvals rather than a general event-to-action rule builder. Missing for 10: arbitrary event triggers and action types, documented rule conditions/configuration depth, automation of external payments, programmatic or AI-driven rule definition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: auto-transfer every deposit so you always know what’s tied up and what’s safe to spend
Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
Relay’s auto-transfer rules make it easy by moving your excess cash out of operating accounts and into savings for you.
Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money, though you still need to manually execute external payments.
